project_name.justification: The text refers to the project as the 'Alotta Project' multiple times, for example: 'Benjamin Hill Enters into Option Agreement with Strategic Metals Ltd on the Alotta Property'.

company_name.justification: The initial buyer was Benjamin Hill Mining Corp., which appears to have been renamed. The most recent articles identify the company as Forge Resources Corp. 'Forge Resources Corp. is a Canadian-listed junior exploration company focused on exploring and advancing the Alotta project...'

ceo_buyer.justification: The CEO of the buyer, Forge Resources Corp., is identified in multiple articles: 'On behalf of the Board of Directors "Cole McClay", CEO Forge Resources Corp.'

interest_acquired_percent.justification: The agreement is an option to acquire a majority stake: '...granting the Company an optional right (the "Option") to earn an undivided 60% joint venture interest in the Alotta Project...'

primary_commodity.justification: The project is described as a porphyry prospect with these commodities: 'The core of the geochemical anomaly is enriched in copper, gold and molybdenum' and 'prospective porphyry copper-gold-molybdenum project'.

verified_article_link.justification: The article at this link is titled 'Benjamin Hill Enters into Option Agreement with Strategic Metals Ltd on the Alotta Property', which directly relates to the acquisition of the Alotta project.

currency.justification: The payment terms are explicitly denominated in Canadian dollars: 'The Option may be exercised by making seven cash payments, totalling $500,000 CAD' and 'aggregate Expenditures of $11,000,000 CAD'.

cash_payments_raw.justification: The total cash consideration under the option agreement is specified: 'The Option may be exercised by making seven cash payments, totalling $500,000 CAD within five years of the execution of the Agreement...'

share_payments_raw.justification: The shares mentioned are part of a finder's fee agreement with a third party, not consideration to the seller (Optionor). The text states: '...finder's fee agreement with William Morris-Nelson... pursuant to which Mr. Morris-Nelson will receive consideration up to 300,000 common shares of the Company...'

cash_and_share_payments_combined_raw.justification: Cash payments are explicitly detailed, so this field is not applicable per the extraction hierarchy.

amount_of_shares_issued.justification: The shares mentioned are part of a finder's fee agreement with a third party, not consideration to the seller (Optionor). The text states: '...finder's fee agreement with William Morris-Nelson... pursuant to which Mr. Morris-Nelson will receive consideration up to 300,000 common shares of the Company...'

share_warrant_payments_raw.justification: Warrants are mentioned in the context of a non-brokered private placement for financing exploration, not as part of the acquisition consideration for the project.

option_payments_raw.justification: No options were issued as payment for the project itself; the transaction is an option agreement to acquire an interest in the project.

issued_share_price.justification: No shares were issued as part of the consideration to the seller, so there is no associated issue price.

exploration_commitment_meters.justification: The exploration commitment is specified as a monetary value, not in meters of drilling.

exploration_commitment_value_raw.justification: The option agreement includes a significant exploration expenditure requirement: 'The Company must also incur aggregate Expenditures of $11,000,000 CAD over 5 years...'

nsr_acquired_percent.justification: There is no mention of a Net Smelter Royalty (NSR) or Gross Revenue Royalty (GRR) in the terms of the transaction described in the documents.

coverage_area_raw.justification: The most recent article from August 2024 provides the updated total land package size after additional staking: 'The property now covers a total area of 4,343 hectares (43.43 km2).'

coverage_area_unit.justification: The unit for the coverage area is explicitly stated: 'The property now covers a total area of 4,343 hectares (43.43 km2).'

resource_size.justification: The text describes the project as an 'un-drilled porphyry prospect' and provides drilling intercepts, but does not state a formal mineral resource estimate with mass or volume units (e.g., tonnes, ounces).

buyer_ticker_and_exchange.justification: The most recent articles identify the buyer as 'Forge Resources Corp.(CSE: FRG) (OTCQB: FRGGF) (FSE: 5YZ)'.
